name: Enable Injections, Inc.
old_description: Founded in 2010, Enable Injections is a healthcare innovation company committed to improving the patient treatment experience through the development and manufacturing of enFuse.
about:
Enable Injections, Inc. was founded in 2010 by medical device entrepreneur Mike Hooven in Cincinnati, Ohio. Hooven, who previously founded AtriCure and Enable Medical, established the company to develop a wearable drug delivery platform that could administer large volumes of medication subcutaneously. The privately held company has since raised more than $300 million in capital funding to advance its technology.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures the enFuse® system, a purely mechanical, hands-free wearable injector that delivers pharmaceutical and biologic therapeutics subcutaneously. The platform accommodates drug product viscosities ranging from 1 to 100 centipoise and eliminates the need for intravenous infusion, allowing patients to receive treatment through a simple injection under the skin. All design, development, and manufacturing operations are based at the company's Cincinnati headquarters.

Enable Injections serves the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, partnering with companies such as Sanofi, Sobi, and Aptar Digital Health to integrate enFuse with specific therapies. Sanofi’s subcutaneous Sarclisa (iscatuximab) has received regulatory approval in the U.S. and EU for administration via enFuse, while Sobi’s Aspaveli (pegcetacoplan) has obtained CE certification for use with the platform. The company also supports clinical trials and commercial launch planning for partnered combination products.

The company states its technology was driven by patient insights to improve the treatment experience, increase safety, and reduce the time, cost, and burden of chronic disease management. By removing needle-stick hazards and manual mixing steps, enFuse aims to enable patients to perform light to moderate activities during administration. The platform has been recognized by industry publications including Fierce Pharma and PM360 for its novel approach to large-volume subcutaneous delivery.

about:
Endless Energy operates in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, where it has provided energy and water treatment services to customers across Northeastern Pennsylvania for over 40 years. The business is family-owned and operated, though the exact founding year and the names of the founders are not disclosed in public materials.

The company's work centers on three service lines: solar photovoltaic system installation, heating and cooling system installation and maintenance, and water treatment system installation. Through its Elite Contractor status with Fujitsu and Mitsubishi, Endless Energy can offer extended 12-year warranties on equipment from those manufacturers. The firm serves both residential and commercial projects but does not publish facility square footage, employee count, or annual installation volumes.

The client base spans homeowners — who report outcomes such as near-zero summer electric bills and full capture of solar incentives — and commercial property owners seeking energy efficiency and comfort upgrades. Every engagement begins with a free, no-commitment quote so costs are known upfront.

Endless Energy cites its multi-decade local presence, family ownership, and direct access to manufacturer-backed warranty programs as the factors that distinguish it from competitors in the region.

name: EnerSys
old_description: Manufactures industrial batteries and energy storage systems.
about:
EnerSys is headquartered in Reading, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 1974. The company manufactures industrial batteries and energy storage systems for critical power applications.

EnerSys produces a range of power solutions including application-specific batteries, high-performance chargers, monitoring and fleet management systems, and integrated energy systems. The portfolio spans brands such as Alpha, Bren-Tronics, NexSys, Odyssey, and Rebel. The company also provides maintenance, repair, training, and technical support services. Operations are global, with subsidiaries around the world.

The company serves industries including logistics and warehousing, communication networks, cable broadband, data centers, aerospace and defense, industrial power and utilities, transportation, medical, safety and security, and 5G infrastructure. Case studies highlight a food and beverage distributor using NexSys TPPL batteries for lift trucks, a telecommunications provider in Milan deploying DataSafe UPS batteries, and support for KEK in maintaining uninterrupted power supply.

EnerSys states its mission is delivering solutions rather than simply selling products, emphasizing a full turnkey power solution backed by global teams and diverse expertise. The company aims to help customers achieve their goals with products and services.

name: EnergySage
old_description: Compare solar quotes and see long-term savings for your home.
about:
EnergySage operates from Boston, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 2009. The company was developed with funding from the U.S. Department of Energy to create a marketplace that makes clean home energy solutions affordable and accessible.

EnergySage runs a digital marketplace that connects homeowners with pre-screened, certified solar installers, allowing users to compare multiple quotes and access free, unbiased Energy Advisors. The platform also facilitates home battery installation through a partnership with Qmerit, and provides resources for EV charging, heat pumps, and electrician services. The company reports that over 60,000 homeowners have electrified their homes through the platform, generating 763 GWh of electricity annually.

The marketplace primarily serves residential customers seeking solar, storage, EV charging, and heat pump solutions. EnergySage also partners with utilities, trade organizations, government entities, and corporations to offer clean energy programs to their constituents.

The company states its mission is to simplify the solar shopping experience and make clean energy accessible to all, leveraging its DOE-backed marketplace model to provide transparent pricing and vetted installer networks.

name: Enovix
old_description: Silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries with proprietary 3D cell architecture
about:
Enovix is headquartered in Fremont, California, and was founded in 2007 in Silicon Valley with the goal of reinventing the lithium-ion battery architecture. The company became publicly listed on NASDAQ (ENVX) in 2021 and operates as a manufacturer of advanced silicon-anode batteries.

Enovix designs and manufactures lithium-ion batteries using proprietary 3D cell architecture, offering 100% active silicon anodes as well as blended silicon-carbon and graphite platforms. Manufacturing spans multiple owned facilities: a high-volume Fab2 in Malaysia for advanced silicon-anode batteries, electrode coating and cell production lines in South Korea for blended platforms, an innovation hub in the U.S. for materials research and cell design, and an AI-driven R&D center in India.

The company serves consumer electronics, drones and autonomous systems, defense and public safety, and medical and industrial markets. Its defense-oriented cells are TAA-compliant with a secure, in-house supply chain. A recent 100,000-battery order for drones illustrates its scale in the autonomous systems sector.

Enovix says its differentiation lies in a fundamentally different battery design that delivers higher energy density without sacrificing cycle life or charging speed, backed by TAA-compliant, in-house manufacturing and flexible chemistries tailored to custom requirements for demanding applications.

name: Envision, LLC
old_description: Helping Customers Bring Innovative Products to Market Quickly
about:
Envision, LLC was founded in 1990 by Jim Friedrich in Huntsville, Alabama. The company began as a manufacturer's representative firm focused on bringing "Engineering Vision" to customers in the southeastern United States and remains privately held.

The firm provides manufacturer's representation and sales engineering services, aligning customer design needs with technology solutions from its principal manufacturers. Its service portfolio includes technical support, design assistance, and territory management across Alabama, Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee. The company operates regional offices in Huntsville, AL; Apex, NC (corporate headquarters); and Atlanta, GA.

Envision serves a broad range of industries including industrial, medical, military & aerospace, off-road & off-highway, artificial intelligence, automotive, consumer electronics, digital signage, electric vehicles, gaming, IoT, metering, networking, retail, servers, telecommunications, agriculture, and white goods. Customers range from startups to large corporations seeking electronic components, interconnects, power solutions, wireless modules, and embedded computing technologies.

The company emphasizes three core principles—passion, integrity, and character—and positions itself as a advisor and extension of its principals' sales forces, leveraging over 30 years of customer service and engineering expertise to bring innovative products to market quickly.
